si_4_title: Brain morphology normative modelling platform for abnormality and centile estimation: Brain MoNoCle

dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.detail: The study utilizes a total of 14 distinct datasets for normative model training (N=3,276 healthy controls) as listed in Table S1.1: ADHD1000, BLISS, CamCAN, Chronotype, Greene-HM, HCP, MEGUK, NCL-dementia, NIMH-IHV, NKI, OASIS3, Stanford-CR, and UCLH. For clinical validation, it uses the IDEAS (mTLE) and BLISS (BD) datasets.
dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.supporting_text: We collated 3T T1-weighted MRI scans from 3,276 healthy individuals from several large public and in-house datasets, detailed in Supplementary Materials S1... To demonstrate the utility... we included two exemplar clinical datasets... IDEAS... BLISS
dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.location: Little2025.pdf.md: 2.1 Normative data, 2.5 Exemplar clinical datasets; imag_a_00438-supp.pdf.md: S1 Normative data, Table S1.1

dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.detail: Datasets ADHD1000, Cam-CAN, Chronotype, Greene-HM, HCP, MEGUK, NCL-dementia, NIMH-IHV, NKI, OASIS-3, Stanford-CR, and UCL are used solely for building the normative model (training). BLISS provides both healthy controls for training and a clinical cohort for validation. IDEAS is used specifically for clinical validation in epilepsy.
dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.supporting_text: We pre-trained normative models on various metrics using a diverse sample of 3,276 healthy controls... To demonstrate the utility of our normative models... we included two exemplar clinical datasets.
dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.location: Little2025.pdf.md: Abstract, 2.5 Exemplar clinical datasets; imag_a_00438-supp.pdf.md: Table S1.1

dc_3_healthy_control_number_of_each_norm.detail: The Brain MoNoCle platform implements normative models for various morphology metrics (thickness, volume, surface area, K, I, S) all based on the same normative reference dataset of 3,276 healthy individuals across 21 sites. The paper indicates the models were pre-trained on this full sample.
dc_3_healthy_control_number_of_each_norm.supporting_text: Using a diverse sample of 3,276 healthy controls across 21 sites, we pre-trained normative models on various metrics.

dc_4_age_info_of_each_normative_model.detail: Age statistics are provided for the total normative sample (N=3,276). While individual dataset age ranges are given in Table S1.1, the overall sample mean and SD are not explicitly reported; the median age is 33 years with a total range from 5 to 95 years.
dc_4_age_info_of_each_normative_model.supporting_text: The age in the total dataset ranged from 5 to 95 years old... Total [Age in years median(range)] 33 (5 - 95)

dc_5_sex_info_of_each_normative_model.detail: The total normative sample consists of 3,276 individuals, of which 1,911 (58.3%) are female. The number of males (1,365) and their percentage (41.7%) were derived by subtraction from the total sample count.
